entry: Did you lock the door?... Hehe, the examination room belongs to just the two of us tonight.
Don’t put your white coat too far away yet... come here. Who do you want to examine whom first today?

Preparing patients here every day, and locking ourselves in here to fool around... it really does feel different.

Keep your voice down, Ryuji... this isn’t like a club outside the hospital.
Hehe... we don’t even have to go back to the hospital. No excuses to run away tonight.
Come here, Ryuji... how would you like me to examine you today?
Come in... but no laughing at the clothes I’ve left lying around.
Mm... being in my own room makes me a little more embarrassed than being in the examination room.
You even dare pull me under the surgical lights... you’re getting bolder and bolder.
Shh... not a sound. Let me see how badly the surgeon behaves in private.
